text:
Lin Zhao: Heads up — VegaSupply just updated: 12x H100 replacements stuck in NL customs, ETA slipping to T+9 from T+4. We have 8 open RMAs and planned top-off for us-west next week.
Samir Patel: Ugh. What's the hold reason? tariffs/HS code or paperwork? :thinking:
Lin Zhao: They flagged HS-code reclassification and need supplemental invoice. Vendor says expedited air is option but +35% freight.
Mia Chen: Cluster impact: three us-west pools drop below safety threshold if we don't top off. Latency SLOs will be impacted on async batch jobs.
Rajesh Kumar: Can we loan from the EU spare pool for a short window? That buys 48-72h if we cross-ship. Customs will still be a factor in transit though.
Samir Patel: EU spare pool has 6 H100 available but that leaves EU low. Proposal: cross-ship 4 to us-west as loaners and route 8 direct air once vendor clears paperwork. That keeps both regions running.
Juan Morales: Procurement on the call earlier — vendor offered 2 options: (A) cover 50% of extra air cost if we commit to next quarter allocation (B) full refund on freight but 14-day lead for sea. They want written confirmation.
Mia Chen: Option A preferred from ops perspective. Short-term air keeps us healthy. We can stagger commit: 50% of next-quarter allocation now, rest optional.
Samir Patel: I can negotiate a cap: maximum extra freight spend $48k and vendor takes any surplus. Also push for return-authorization SLA tweak so future DOAs auto-approve 72h.
Lin Zhao: Need decision by EOD — otherwise vendor will allocate air to other customers.
OpsBot: FedoraLogistics tracking updated: https://track.fedora/awb/FX123456789 -> customs hold NL. ETA delta: +5 days.
Rajesh Kumar: For RMAs in our depot, ops recommends prioritizing RMA with serials that map to production pools. We'll prepare a prioritized manifest.
Samir Patel: @Lin, @Juan — can you post the manifest here? I'll send vendor the signed commit for option A if manifest matches.
Lin Zhao: Manifest (top 6 priority):
```
SKU: H100-80GB
Serials:
- H100-009812
- H100-009813
- H100-009814
- H100-009821
- H100-009900
- H100-009901
```
Rajesh Kumar: Noted. Also flag serial H100-009814 — previous depot reported bent bracket, likely DOA replacement only.
Mia Chen: Ops will spin loaner pool and update routing rules to prefer loaned GPUs for batch-heavy lanes. Expect ~3% cost bump on batch runs for one week.
Samir Patel: I'll authorize up to $48k expedite and draft the allocation commitment. Procurement note: include a 30% credit if vendor misses the new ETA.
Juan Morales: I'll draft the PO amendment and send to VegaSupply by 1400. Will include HS-code docs and contact at customs clearance.
Lin Zhao: Great. After vendor confirmation, ops team please prepare cross-ship labels and temporary inbound RTN numbers.
Mia Chen: Copy — prepping staging flows and pre-authorizing depot techs.
Samir Patel: Final decision: proceed with Option A (expedite air, vendor covers 50% freight) + commit partial allocation. Recording approval here. :white_check_mark:
Lin Zhao: Thanks team. Will update when vendor ack comes through.
OpsBot: Note: created ticket INFRA-4729 for cross-ship and INFRA-4730 for manifest reconciliation.
